source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit, in builds with all of rytm2_mods' OS 1.74 ports
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: FZ74, the released core-ar2 0.3 with Filter Hz alone, passed all five steps on 2026-10-22: boot, FRQ fully left 13.8Hz, fully right 21.1kHz and one step back 19.9kHz, RES a plain number, and a minute of playback while turning FRQ, with samples and delay and reverb sends on all tracks, with no freezes or dropouts. Earlier, in C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 before #153, all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports, 2026-10-20) each mod's own test passed, and in R8T2 (2026-10-18) the same readings were seen.
scope: filter-hz 1.0 (rytm2_mods' OS 1.74 port): alone with the released core-ar2 0.3 (FZ74), and beside other rytm2_mods ports (C3A4, R8T2).

builds.label: FZ74
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 (elekloader core-ar2-v0.3, with #153) and rytm2_mods v1.2's Filter Hz, linked by Modwerk's linker on stock 1.74. Modwerk's own 1.2.0 package links to the same main OS (source-parity.json).
results: Boots to the main screen; sounds play as on stock.
FRQ fully right: 21.1kHz; one step back: 19.9kHz.
RES still shows a plain number.
A minute of playback while turning FRQ, with samples and delay and reverb sends on all tracks: no freezes or dropouts (heard over Overbridge).

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153 (velocity-route interrupt masking), and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: Each mod's own test passed, including Filter Hz's (FRQ popup in Hz and kHz).

builds.label: R8T2
builds.content: core-ar2 0.1 ported to 1.74 and eight rytm2_mods ports, with rytm2_mods v1.1's Filter Hz release object. Its source is v1.2's; the shared include has two more symbol names in v1.2.
results: FRQ fully right: 21.1kHz; one step back: 19.9kHz.
RES still shows a plain number.

individualTestResults: FZ74 (alone, released core): boot, 13.8Hz / 21.1kHz / 19.9kHz, RES plain, a minute of playback with samples and delay/reverb sends on all tracks, no freezes or dropouts
Filter Hz's own test passed with core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven ports (C3A4)
FRQ popup reads 13.8Hz, 21.1kHz and 19.9kHz at 0, 127 and 126 (R8T2)

contextNote: Main OS hashes are the builds', not read back from the device. FZ74's main OS is the one Modwerk's 1.2.0 build gives. C3A4's core predates #153.
